# Digital Creator Academy

> Digital Creator Academy is an online academy teaching practical digital skills. Learn Today, Grow Tomorrow. New students can join a free trial class.

Website: https://digitalcreatoracademy.qd.je

## Courses

- Content Creation — how to create engaging short-form video content for TikTok and other platforms
- TikTok Shop Affiliate — how to earn as a TikTok Shop affiliate by promoting products
- Client Hunting — how to find and win online clients as a freelancer
- Website Development — how to build websites step by step
